title: Name key of a Condé-party nomenclator in Saintonge and Guyenne, du Lau du Chambon's copy: 110 persons and places coded 17-186 in Roman numerals, with a number table; no letter in this key identified
correspondents: Condé's party in Saintonge, Aunis and Guyenne (Armand du Lau du Chambon's copy)
shelfmark: AD Dordogne, 2 E 1841/18 (du Lau du Chambon papers), name table on frames P1370715-717 of the 2026 photographs
folio_note: Three pages (photographer's frames P1370715-717): 'Noms propres de personnes, villes, bourgs et rivières', 110 entries (46 persons, 64 places) under initials A-V with Roman-numeral codes 17-186, and a 'Nombre' table mapping numbers to the capitals A-Z. Codes 1-16 and any letter or syllable table are missing. Transcribed in targets/conde1651/key_names_1652.tsv.
status: A second key found in the bundle of catalogue 1213 (conde1651, PR #937, Brice Dudout with AI agents, 23 Nov 2026). It is not the key of the five 1651 cipher letters (0 of 9 known name codes agree) and none of the letters in the bundle uses it; the 1652 letters there are in clear. The names (Harcourt, Plessis-Bellière, Folleville, Montausier, Saint-Luc, le Mazarin; Condé, Conti, Marsin, Tarente, Nemours, Baltazar, Chouppes, du Daugnon; Brouage, Taillebourg, Tonnay-Charente, Saintes, Pons, Cognac, Barbezieux, Oléron, Ré) fit late 1651 to 1652; 'M. de Chambon' (45) is du Lau himself. Not in Brianson (BSHAP 1983), his key sheets or typescripts in the bundle, catalogue.json, leads.json or targets/ (contributor's check, 23 Nov 2026). Photographs by Catherine Schunck (SHAP) for the project, not distributed; the transcription is by AI agents and was not checked by a person on the images. Filed by the maintainers at the integration of PR #937 (27 Nov 2026); not vetted.
why: A name key of the princes' Fronde in the south-west: any 1651-1652 cipher letter of Condé's network (du Lau, Marsin, Baltazar, Viole, du Daugnon, Tarente, Lenet's papers, the Chantilly decipherment tables of lead 1846) with names as numbers 17-186 can be tested against it.
score_note: Scored by the maintainers at the integration of PR #937 (27 Nov 2026) from targets/conde1651/NOTES.md and key_names_1652.tsv; the images were seen by the contributor's agents, not by the project. Solvability 2: a names-only part of a key with no letter in it identified.
verify: Search DECODE, Tomokiyo and Lasry for a Condé or Fronde name table with codes 17-186; look in Lenet's papers and the Chantilly tables (lead 1846) for letters whose names fall in 17-186; ask the contributor to check a few rows of key_names_1652.tsv on the images.
source: GitHub pull request #937 (Brice Dudout, bdudout, with AI agents): the table is studied in targets/conde1651/NOTES.md; row written by the maintainers at integration
access_note: The 2026 photographs are held by the project and the SHAP and are not distributed; the AD Dordogne has not put 2 E 1841 online.
